svg.text: View 2 — Serving Anthropic (Claude) via Microsoft Foundry + APIM on Azure AI Landing Zones

Same control plane as the current GPT-5.4 implementation — only the Foundry model deployment changes (Claude instead of GPT-5.4). Agent 365 / Foundry Agent Service · Entra ID · APIM AI Gateway · Defender/Purview.
Client / Consumer layer (outside the Azure tenant)
Programmatic consumers — architect-v1 · dev-agent · external apps
model calls → APIM (AI Gateway) · app UX → Application Gateway
↓ Entra-authenticated calls into the landing zones
Management Groups (Azure tenant) — landing-zone hierarchy + tenant governance
Connectivity Subscription (Platform) — Hub VNet (region 1..N) · DNS provided by hub
↕ VNet peering to spoke landing zones (Foundry + AI Gateway)
Foundry Landing Zone Subscription (spoke · region-1 stamp)
AI Gateway Landing Zone Subscription (spoke · region-1 stamp)
AI Gateway (API Center / Universal AI Registry)
Consumers (architect-v1 · dev-agent · external apps) → APIM → Foundry (Claude)
Role assignments · Policy assignments · Tags (inherited from management group)

Request path: Consumer → APIM (AI Gateway, Entra-authenticated, quota/cache/safety) → Microsoft Foundry (Foundry model deployment = Claude) → response. Identity: Entra ID · Agents: Agent 365 / Foundry Agent Service · Governance: Defender + Purview + Azure Policy.
